assets.title: Bastion faction key art
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: review-only concept art for a Godot RTS, not a finished game asset. Project: Bastion, the first heavy mechanized faction in an original modern military-inspired RTS with exaggerated near-future technology. Art direction: polished stylized 3D concept rendering, broad readable shapes, deliberately oversized functional weapons, layered industrial armor, strong silhouette separation at RTS camera distance, controlled surface detail and clear material separation. Recognizable tanks and human soldiers alongside programmable robots and drones, not space fantasy. Cohesive faction design language: low broad armored shapes, chamfered rectangular modules, substantial tracks and practical service access; a small recessed replaceable control-chip module and modest status light on programmable machines, no floating code or holographic UI. Use restrained military-industrial coloration with clear team-marking surfaces, avoiding unnecessary decorative noise. Original designs, no real-world faction flags, no copied C&C units, no existing franchise logos. No gore, no watermark, no fake game UI.
Primary request: Create one striking widescreen faction key-art scene establishing Bastion's identity. At an armored forward base, a powerful tracked main battle tank is the visual anchor, with a few individually readable mechanized infantry, a compact repair robot near the tank, and a reconnaissance drone above. A robust vehicle factory and command facility frame the midground; distant artillery silhouettes suggest a larger force. Make conventional military engineering visibly evolve into exaggerated programmable technology. Composition: elevated three-quarter cinematic overview, enough of the tank roof and rear to read its form, clear visual hierarchy and generous separation between unit types; dramatic but legible daylight with atmospheric distance. Mood: disciplined industrial strength, repairability, coordinated combined arms. No battle damage spectacle obscuring the design. No text.

Primary request: Create one landscape studio concept-design board with three spacious columns on a clean warm-neutral background. Column 1: a conventional mechanized infantry soldier, full-body three-quarter pose, with one smaller rear view; human proportions, armored vest and helmet, readable rifle silhouette, not a giant exosuit. Column 2: the reference-inspired broad tracked main battle tank with a conventional oversized single cannon, dominant three-quarter view and a smaller directly overhead view of the SAME tank beneath it. Column 3: an advanced variant of that same tank family with an exaggerated angular electromagnetic cannon and visible recessed programmable control module, dominant three-quarter view and smaller overhead view beneath. Tank columns must preserve family resemblance while visibly separating conventional and advanced equipment. Accurate consistent components between views are important; no exploded internals. Distinct separated silhouettes, no props overlapping. Minimal text only these exact headings above their respective columns: "INFANTRY", "MAIN BATTLE TANK", "ADVANCED ARMOR". Short board title "BASTION / GROUND FORCES". No further text. Readable typesetting, subtle layout rules without decorative colored borders. The advanced weapon and module are visual explorations, not engineering diagrams.

Combat robot: compact squat four-legged armored weapons platform, larger than a person but much smaller than a tank, not a humanoid giant.
